title: The mass gap over the compact simple groups
description: A manuscript developing a constructive approach to the lattice mass gap over every simply connected compact simple group, together with its in-progress Lean 4 formalization: two libraries, MassGap and MassGapChecks, Lean core alone, every declaration at the empty axiom set and every check module decided by the kernel. The relativistic continuum construction includes a pending mathematical obligation for exact spacetime covariance. The TeX is authoritative and the Lean is its transcription. The README gives an overview of established results and the mathematical and formalization work still to complete.
